patterns.title: Drive the shipped surface
patterns.summary: Exercise the artifact and boundary a user actually receives before treating tests or code reading as behavioral proof.

skills.name: before-after
skills.summary: Browser-openable before/after artifacts for visual behavior, benchmark deltas, and feature tours. Registered after repeated personal use across wterm work; no baseline comparison has been completed.

provenance.summary: Before After has repeated personal use and a registration decision, but no public repository case yet proves an application of the published procedure.

gaps.description: Record one public case that applies the published procedure and preserves the resulting artifact or durable evidence.

skills.name: factory-loop
skills.summary: Master router for one admitted engineering cycle. It enters at the earliest incomplete state, delegates phase methods, invalidates stale downstream evidence, and stops at explicit mutation and promotion gates.

provenance.summary: Factory Loop has one complete public dogfood case proving exact-state routing and evidence invalidation, without a baseline comparison.

gaps.description: Compare the complete router against ad hoc phase selection on a transfer work item.

skills.name: handoff
skills.summary: End-of-cycle handoff derived from twelve hand-written handoffs across vcut, petdex, portless, wterm, gateway-spend, and agent-browser. Promoted on Hunter's direct call after heavy personal dogfooding; a dedicated repository case is still owed.

provenance.summary: Handoff was promoted on direct human report of repeated personal use, while the catalog audit found no retrievable application record.

gaps.description: Record the next real handoff as a public or approved-private application with a retrievable artifact.

skills.name: herdr-workstreams
skills.summary: Runtime adapter for materializing selected workstreams as repo-scoped Herdr workspaces and launching specialists visibly on demand. Derived from one live portfolio design session; no end-to-end dogfood run has completed.

provenance.summary: Herdr Workstreams is derived from one portfolio topology design session and has no completed end-to-end setup run.

gaps.description: Run setup twice on real repositories and prove exact workspace reuse, visible specialist recovery, and no duplicate topology.

skills.name: issue-intake
skills.summary: Canonical contributor-side intake gate. It qualifies a bounded shortlist, keeps the final choice human, optionally uses xref as graph evidence, and seeds the Issue Contract without owning reproduction or implementation.

provenance.summary: Issue Intake has a focused contract evaluation for its xref and human-choice boundary, but no retrievable application case under the renamed procedure.

gaps.description: Record one real shortlist and human selection that stops before reproduction or mutation.

skills.name: performance-proof
skills.summary: Measurement-first performance workflow. Frozen outside the default issue workflow and invoked only for an evidenced performance claim.

provenance.summary: Performance Proof remains an unproven conditional method with no recorded application in the Foundry corpus.

gaps.description: Apply the method to one evidenced performance claim and preserve baseline, variance, artifact identity, and rollback proof.

skills.name: quality-baseline
skills.summary: Read-only repository quality baseline. Ran on portless #369 and surfaced the untested write paths that led directly to the fix. Baseline comparison remains pending.

provenance.summary: Quality Baseline has a public application where the audit exposed untested write paths that led directly to a fix.

gaps.description: Compare the audit against unstructured repository inspection on a transfer repository.

skills.name: record-a-case
skills.summary: Used to capture real public maintenance work and backfills as evidence ledgers. Promoted to the stable distribution surface; it has not completed a baseline comparison.

provenance.summary: Record a Case now has an explicit schema 2 application that links a reviewed case to compiled knowledge without mutating installable procedure.

skills.name: resilience-audit
skills.summary: Failure-path audit. Frozen outside the default issue workflow and invoked only when timeout, cancellation, retry, cleanup, overload, or concurrency risk triggers it.

provenance.summary: Resilience Audit now has public run evidence that forced failure and pressure paths, despite its older experimental registry summary.

gaps.description: Run a promotion round that evaluates the newer application corpus and updates or retains maturity explicitly.

skills.name: review-gate
skills.summary: Pre-review gate harvested from maintainer review rounds across agent-browser and portless cases. Blind replication round 002 compared the method against an answer key and exposed both catches and verification losses.

provenance.summary: Review Gate is backed by recorded applications and a blind answer-key evaluation, including evidence of both catches and misses.

skills.name: security-review
skills.summary: Threat-boundary review that separates exploitable vulnerabilities from hardening, non-security defects, and verification gaps. One five-case baseline comparison passed 18/18 assertions versus 16/18 without the skill; transfer and repeated trials remain pending.

provenance.summary: Security Review separates exploitability and trust-boundary evidence from merge policy, lifecycle defects, and defense-in-depth hardening.

gaps.description: Record a complete real-work application whose exact-state receipt is consumed by Review Gate.
Repeat the comparison on a held-out repository and stack, then run multiple trials per configuration.

skills.name: signature-repro
skills.summary: Niche triage for bugs that require unavailable hardware or platforms, using structural or visual signatures on available machines. Applied as written on agent-browser #1461 and needed no revision. Baseline eval round still pending.

provenance.summary: Signature Repro was applied as written to agent-browser #1461 when the reporter platform was unavailable.

gaps.description: Compare structural-signature triage against an unstructured unavailable-platform investigation.

skills.name: simplify
skills.summary: Bounded behavior-preserving reduction workflow derived from a real feature simplification below a PR line budget. Deterministic, Test Strength, Resilience, and external review gates passed; baseline comparison remains pending.

provenance.summary: Simplify was derived from one recorded feature reduction that met a line budget while preserving behavior and verification gates.

gaps.description: Compare against no skill and broad quality audit on a transfer feature while scoring clarity and behavior preservation.

skills.name: software-factory
skills.summary: Staged execution protocol between Solution Gate and Review Gate. It separates implementation, reduction, applicable resilience hardening, final-code Test Strength, and real-behavior proof. Contract tests cover ordering and stale evidence, but no real run or baseline comparison has been recorded.

provenance.summary: Software Factory has contract tests and a registration rationale, but no recorded real-work application of the complete staged protocol.

gaps.description: Run the full protocol on real work and measure whether staging adds a catch beyond direct use of the delegated methods.

skills.name: solution-gate
skills.summary: Orchestrates Shaping before implementation: freezes the evidence-backed contract, runs isolated Shaping passes, probes weak assumptions, feeds evidence back into fit checks, and gates the surviving shape before detailing. Promoted to stable on Hunter's direct call; formal baseline comparison remains pending.

provenance.summary: Solution Gate has repeated public run evidence, including isolated proposals, synthesis, holdout comparison, and evidence-fed correction.

gaps.description: Complete a formal no-skill and released-skill comparison across transfer holdouts.

skills.name: test-strength
skills.summary: Test effectiveness workflow using falsification, mutation, properties, real boundaries, and artifact checks. Applied inside real Review Gate runs on portless #366 and #374. Baseline comparison remains pending.

provenance.summary: Test Strength has public application records where deliberate mutations failed at the intended behavioral assertions and recovered after restoration.

gaps.description: Compare the method against ordinary test execution on held-out changes.

skills.name: trail-decisions
skills.summary: Append-only decision trail written to the canonical Foundry during implementation so review can audit choices, not only the diff. Redesigned after the lifecycle audit and awaiting one real dogfood run.

provenance.summary: Trail Decisions has forward-looking references but no recorded run of the published append-only procedure.

gaps.description: Use the procedure during implementation and show that the resulting trail lets review audit a consequential choice not recoverable from the final diff.

skills.name: work-intake
skills.summary: Read-only admission assessment for one already-selected issue, pull request, or manual request. It classifies intent, recommends the minimum workflow, and stops for human confirmation before mutation authority is granted.

provenance.summary: Work Intake has a registered read-only contract and no recorded application to a selected issue, pull request, or manual request.

gaps.description: Record one real admission assessment that recommends the minimum workflow and stops for human confirmation before mutation.

skills.name: workstream-reconcile
skills.summary: Revalidates handoff and portfolio claims against live GitHub, local Git, releases, deployments, and package artifacts, then classifies drift and stalled work into a current read-only queue. Applied twice on real Vercel Labs portfolio work; no baseline comparison yet.

provenance.summary: Workstream Reconcile was applied twice on real portfolio work, with public-safe outcomes compiled into its registration record.

gaps.description: Compare against ad hoc use of handoff, issue-radar, and xref on a transfer portfolio.

skills.name: xref
skills.summary: Snapshots the reference graph of a GitHub pull request or issue to surface orphans, competing work, structural links, and file-overlap risks. Registered after repeated real use; no baseline comparison yet.

provenance.summary: xref has a public run corpus across multiple issues and pull requests, including a triage analysis grounded in current graph and runtime evidence.

gaps.description: Run trigger and negative-trigger evals plus a no-skill comparison on a fresh issue.
